design.legacy_update_audit: pre/post qualification only; uninstrumented timing/profile; independent profile task counts
design.profile_label_scope: replay and final join; preparation completed before each label

timing_boundaries.wall_us: Actual preparation, required H2D, producer/update, replay, final join.
timing_boundaries.queue_span_us: Queue span includes submission gaps and waits; not kernel time.
timing_boundaries.preparation_enqueue_us: Host fill/enqueue; not completed H2D duration.
timing_boundaries.submit_join_cpu_us: Submission and join overlaps device work; do not add to queue.

limitations: Two process blocks are a bounded screen, not a stable speedup estimate.
Profiler labels and task durations include profiler effects and are separate from wall trials.
MEM_WAIT, CPU updates and DMA overlap; do not add them as an endpoint decomposition.
No AIC metrics: MM1/MM2, bandwidth, core imbalance and FD cost are not localized.
Fixed resident attention inputs; no model layers, token generation or serving.
